description:
Hong Yi-Jeong, who is naturally sociable and loves people, one day happens to hear rumors about Ki Tae-Rim, the biggest outsider in his department. With thick glasses, messy hair, and a carelessly thrown-on plaid shirt, Tae-Rim looked like the textbook definition of an outsider. But when Lee Jung-Eun realized that everything he was wearing was designer brand, he resolved to avoid him at all costs—only to run into him at the opening ceremony… and find himself inexplicably drawn to him, constantly glancing his way.

“He’s such a pushover.”

Uncomfortable with Lee Jung-Eun’s kindness, Tae-Rim tries to tease him by seducing him after he notices his hickey. Captivated by Tae-Rim’s inexplicable charm, Lee Jung-Eun ends up spending the night with him…!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
